rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page text layer) names the item. Text cells and combs: caption left of or above the cell. Booleans: X in the box immediately left of the printed option (quarter, amended, type, ATC, foreign tax credit, tax rate, method, spouse options). ATC booleans follow the printed grid order, read row by row (Part I: II012, II014, II013 / II015, II017, II016; Part II first row: II012, II014, II013, II011, then II015, II017, II016). Part III, Part IV and Part V (page 2) amounts are whole-peso 8-slot combs with no centavo comb (the print says not to enter centavos), so each one takes a peso_joins entry that prints the amount rounded to whole pesos. Part IV dates are three combs per row under one key: date_joins split the writer date across them. The page 2 TIN is one 14-slot comb: it prints derived:tin_digits (Form1701QDraft::to_print_field_map). The item 5 and item 17 branch combs (p1c22, p1c72) are mixed cells with no input element, so they stay blank. TIN combs carry catalog name stamps and take no join. Layout keys with no printed cell (txtCurrentPage, txtMaxPage, txtLOB, txtTelno, txtFinalFlag, txtEnroll, ebirOnline*, driveSelectTPExport) have no cell to fill. Since #113 the Part V (specify) boxes print too and every other value has a reviewed not_joined reason.
